build_semsegnet: build a 3D convolutional semantic segmentation neural network with configurable embedding and hidden dimensions
run_semsegnet_cli: run the SemSegNet module via argparse CLI to instantiate a model with custom hyperparameters
create_semsegwrapper: create a SemSegWrapper to load a pretrained model and segment voxel blocks into semantic classes
test_segment_object: test the SemSegWrapper segment_object method to classify non-air blocks in a voxel grid
review_semsegnet_forward: review the SemSegNet forward pass that embeds block IDs and applies stacked 3D conv layers
